name: Immich
description: High-performance photo & video backup with ML search, faces, mobile auto-upload.
compose:
services:
  immich:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:release
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:2283"
    volumes:
      - ${{cfg.upload_dir}}:/usr/src/app/upload
    restart: unless-stopped
